deliberately_unchanged:
- Issue steps 2 and 3. Step 2 is a 62-page hand-judgement; step 3 is blocked on it. #205
  must STAY OPEN — this PR closes only step 1.
- Page status, document status, escalation and routing. Explicitly guarded by
  test_surfacing_does_not_key_page_status_scope_guard, which fails if a bare TR-3 hard-fail
  outside --native-only ever emits the demotion event or sets needs_ocr_enhancement.
- The existing --native-only conjunction at orchestrator.py:809 and the D3-floor event at
  assemble. Both left byte-identical; the new emission is a separate additive loop.
- The is_numeric_token notation gaps (.034, U+2217 stars) that plausibly inflate the 25.3%.
  Filed separately by the issue.
- Rejected alternative: suppressing the new event under --native-only so no existing test
  moves. That would make surfacing conditional again (the defect) and force a consumer to
  know both kinds AND which mode ran. One kind, one meaning, mode-independent, is better.
